title: Removal Retention Rate for Optional Coverage Add-Ons Riders by Other Active Bridgewell Plans
content:
The removal retention rate applied when an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider is removed follows the customer's other active Bridgewell plans: a plan of the Utility Line Protection Plans and an agreement of the HVAC Maintenance Agreements, each counted only while in active status.

| Utility line protection plan in active status | HVAC maintenance agreement in active status | Removal retention rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Zero |
| Yes | No | 0.05 (5 percent) |
| No | Yes | 0.05 (5 percent) |
| No | No | 0.10 (10 percent) |

**Hypothetical cases.**

- A customer with an active Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan and an active Bridgewell Comfort Care Plus agreement removes a rider: the removal retention rate is zero.
- A customer with only an active HVAC maintenance agreement: 0.05.
- A customer whose utility line plan was cancelled and who holds no HVAC maintenance agreement: neither is held in active status, and the rate is 0.10.
